description: This file contains utility functions, constants, and imports related to end-to-end testing of the Notesnook web application, including functions for creating and editing notes, file handling, and test configuration.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Type definition for a note with a title and optional content.

classes.name: AppModel
classes.description: Imported class representing the application model used in tests.

methods.name: getTestId
methods.description: Generates a test ID selector string for locating elements.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note in the application using Playwright page object.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Edits the content and title of a note in the application.

methods.name: downloadAndReadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file via a page action and reads its content.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file through a file chooser triggered on the page.

methods.name: isTestAll
methods.description: Checks if the environment variable TEST_ALL is set to true.

methods.name: createHistorySession
methods.description: Sets up a test session with note editing and locking, returning session details.
